The '''Garyn Raider Base''' was a bunker located a considerable distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was controlled by the [[Garyn Raiders]],<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> a criminal organization founded by ex-[[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Alexi Garyn]].<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Garyn Raider base was located a relatively short distance away from a mysterious [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] shrine. The base was staffed by a number of Raiders known as "shivs," and included a display area consisting of four [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Bone/Legends|skulls]].<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==History==
[[File:GarynRaiderBaseInterior.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A display of lightsabers and skulls inside the Garyn Raider Base]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with investigating a series of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] break-ins, including [[Cybernetics Lab|one lab]] in Narmle. The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] by the name of [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] was ultimately implicated in the break-ins. After the spacer investigated the Garyn Raider base, it was concluded that Ponda Baba came to them for assistance, but found his small offer of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to be laughable.<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Garyn Raider Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Garyn Raider Base was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
